en-vs-a-transport.title: "En métro" or "à pied"?
en-vs-a-transport.body: "Closed" means of transport (ones you get inside) use en: en métro, en voiture, en bus. "Open" ways of getting around, where you don't get inside anything — like walking or riding a bike by sitting on top of it — use à: à pied, à vélo. It's a small rule, but it comes up all the time in everyday life.

metro-paris-historia.title: The Paris metro was born at a world's fair
metro-paris-historia.body: The Paris metro opened in 1900, just in time for that year's World's Fair — a huge event that brought millions of visitors to the city. It's one of the oldest metros in the world, and many stations still keep the original cast-iron Art Nouveau entrance designed by Hector Guimard.
